solutions.title: Copy digits before adding
solutions.strategy: Copy each linked-list digit into arrays, then add aligned positions with a carry while building the result chain.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each digit from both inputs is copied once and each result position is produced once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The copied digit arrays store every input value before the addition loop runs.

solutions.title: Stream digits with carry
solutions.strategy: Walk both lists directly, creating one result node per summed digit and carrying overflow into the next position.

timeComplexity.explanation: The loop advances through the longer input once and may add one final carry node.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Aside from the returned result chain, only current pointers, a carry value, and a tail pointer are stored.
